sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01
yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
Tensile result on the Alluminio B BR-220 lot is 245 MPa. The drawing says min 240 MPa so it passes.

findings.why: The measured 245 MPa is below the 250 MPa minimum of SC-01 in the drawing in force (Rev C, 2026-06-01) and in the control plan. The 240 MPa limit comes from Rev B, which Rev C replaced, so the lot does not pass. The email EML-SQ-2026-1105 repeats the outdated 6061 / 240 MPa requirement.

Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.

findings.why: The only evidence for the lot is a verbal tensile figure from the meeting. No EN 10204 3.1 certificate or test report for this lot or heat is in the documents. Please confirm the certificate is available and shows the grade, temper and Rp0.2 for this heat.
